name: Naomi
overview: The story of Naomi, introduced in the opening chapter of Ruth, presents her as a woman from Bethlehemjudah who experiences profound loss when her husband Elimelech and her two sons die while living in Moab. Naomi's relationship with her daughters-in-law, particularly Ruth, highlights themes of loyalty and kindness, as seen when Naomi urges them to return to their own families, yet Ruth chooses to stay with her. These events set the stage for a narrative of faithfulness and God's providential care during difficult times.
